en: "O Sugata, may the *Pravāraṇasūtra* be inspired in you, O Lord of Speech! The Blessed One said this, and then the Venerable Vāgīśa at that time spoke this verse:
On this fifteenth day of purification,
five hundred bhikṣus have gathered; all these great sages have severed the bonds of the fetters and their existence is exhausted.
Pure ones, free from rebirth, having abandoned birth and death, having accomplished what was to be done, and being without outflows, wait upon the Pure One.
They sever arrogance, doubt, desire, the knots of pride, and existence;
they extract the thorn of craving, having accumulated no further craving for rebirth.
O Lion, you are without grasping, having abandoned all fear and terror;
you have transcended the acquisitions, and the outflows have been destroyed by you.
Just as a universal monarch, surrounded by his ministers,
governs this earth bounded by the oceans on all sides.
Thus, the disciples who have conquered the battle and attained the threefold knowledge, seeking to transcend death, wait upon you, the supreme caravan leader.
All these seven sons of yours are indeed here; no flood exists in this place.
I salute you, the kinsman of the Ādityas, the remover of all thorns.
The Blessed One said this; and those monks, their minds satisfied, rejoiced in what the Blessed One had spoken.
